description: Lessons topics. Regions first (exam questions and reading by body region), then whole-skeleton topics that only the textbook has. 'regions' are bone regions (content/bones); 'sections' are textbook section ids (content/textbook).

topics.title: Skull
topics.blurb: Cranial and facial bones, sutures, fossae, foramina, the orbit and the nasal cavity

topics.title: Spine

topics.title: Thorax
topics.blurb: Sternum, true, false and floating ribs, and the thoracic cage

topics.title: Upper limb
topics.blurb: Pectoral girdle, humerus, radius and ulna, and the bones of the hand

topics.title: Lower limb
topics.blurb: Femur, patella, tibia and fibula, and the bones of the foot

topics.title: Pelvis
topics.blurb: Hip bones, sacrum and coccyx, and female and male pelvis differences

topics.title: Bone tissue
topics.blurb: What bone does, how it is built, grows, heals and is kept in balance

topics.title: The skeleton
topics.blurb: Axial and appendicular divisions, and how the skeleton develops

topics.title: Joints
topics.blurb: Joint types, synovial joints, body movements and selected joints
